import urllib.request
import urllib.parse
import json

# Test data with correct tier value
test_data = {
    ''name'': ''Test Company'',
    ''tier'': ''free'',
    ''allowed_agents'': [''customer-support'', ''data-analyst'']
}

# API endpoint
url = ''http://localhost:8003/api/v1/auth/register''

try:
    print(f''Testing tenant registration at {url}'')
    print(f''Request data: {json.dumps(test_data, indent=2)}'')

    # Prepare request
    data = json.dumps(test_data).encode(''utf-8'')
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        url,
        data=data,
        headers={''Content-Type'': ''application/json''}
    )

    # Make request
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as response:
        status_code = response.getcode()
        response_data = response.read().decode(''utf-8'')
        
        print(f''Response Status Code: {status_code}'')
        
        if status_code == 200:
            parsed_response = json.loads(response_data)
            print(f''Response Data:'')
            print(json.dumps(parsed_response, indent=2, default=str))
            print(''SUCCESS: Tenant registration successful!'')
            
            # Extract API key
            if ''api_key'' in parsed_response:
                api_key = parsed_response[''api_key'']
                print(f''Generated API Key: {api_key[:20]}...'')
        else:
            print(f''FAILED: Registration failed!'')
            print(f''Response: {response_data}'')

except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    print(f''HTTP Error {e.code}: {e.reason}'')
    error_response = e.read().decode(''utf-8'')
    print(f''Error response: {error_response}'')
except Exception as e:
    print(f''Error: {e}'')
